name: danmaku-echo

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/shared.test.js tests/reply.test.mjs tests/douyin-barrage-model.test.mjs tests/douyin-rich-data.test.mjs tests/douyin-input-order.test.mjs tests/douyin-own-message.test.mjs tests/bilibili-dom-config.test.mjs tests/content-media-safety.test.js tests/live-action-visibility.test.mjs tests/emoji-fallback.test.mjs tests/favorites.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node tests/validate-manifest.js build/extension && node tests/validate-vue-architecture.js && node --check build/extension/src/content.js && node --check build/extension/src/douyin-page-hook.js && node --check build/extension/src/douyin-content.js && node --check tests/fixture-server.js && node --check tests/inspect-live-dom.js && node --check tests/inspect-popup.mjs && npm test
